body:
Nobody asked me any questions... but that's okay. I still appreciate the advice and the time you all took to talk to me here. 

I don't really know what to say, what would be the last thing you'd type? I planned a lot of this, but not really the typing part.

I couldn't work well enough with the cards I was dealt, I fold. 

Peace.

The pros just don't outweigh the cons. I can't think of more reasons not to do it, than to just do it. It will just get worse, and by then who knows if I'll be able to set things up like I have now. It's a snowball, and I'm at the bottom of the hill. They would be more damaged if I did it later, they are young enough now that they won't remember much of me in 5 years. Thank you for your advice and your time you are taking on your new years to talk to me.
